To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new phase shedding and adding control technique for interleaved VF-Dab converters operating in IPOP mode has been proposed and simulated.

the proposed phase shedding technique is able to reduce the losses and improve the efficiency of the IPOP based VF-DAB converter at light load conditions and also it can be used to add or subtract phase at heavy load conditions to improve the power transfer capability of the converter.
the proposed interleaved VF-DABS with phase-shed operation at light loads is a suitable solution for interfacing energy storages devices to the common DC bus.
